testo:
■ Mana Drive 3 (Darkness): When you put this creature into the battle zone, if you have 3 or more cards in your mana zone and one or more of them is darkness civilization, choose one of your opponent's creatures. That creature gets -2000 power until the end of the turn. (A creature that has power 0 or less is destroyed.)
